notes: SVAMITVA drone tiles (1024x1024). mask_color (0,110,255) is the Building class colour defined by the dataset's own poly2mask.py and used by its filter2Binary.py/data_augmentation.py scripts; masks are RGB class colourings, so a '>0' binarisation would mark Field/Road/Water/Other as foreground. split_strategy=contiguous because the tiles are raster-ordered (consecutive indices share exact pixel seams) and all come from a single survey, so there is no scene grouping available: a random tile split would leak near-identical neighbours. Contiguous splitting is spatially disjoint but the index order is not density-neutral (measured: deciles 0-6 are 20-58% building-positive, deciles 7-9 are 78-100%), so test density differs from train. secondary_stratified_eval adds a clearly-labelled leakage-optimistic comparison. random_crop draws 256x256 crops from the native 1024 resolution instead of downscaling, preserving small-building detail. CPU-only training is supported; reduce base_channels/epochs if time-constrained.
